snippet.title: Official Updated Pre-Alpha Steam Trailer –Adventurers Guild Inc.
snippet.description:
In Adventurers Guild Inc. YOU run the business behind the heroics! Hire staff, test adventurers, and master guild politics in this turn-based management game crafted by one dev!

This is an update of the Steam Trailer including the new game logo and new in-game visuals. New gameplay sequences are being worked upon but are not 100% ready to be shown yet so stay tuned!

🎮 Wishlist on Steam: https://tinyurl.com/4j72cawu
💬 Join the community: https://discord.com/invite/eYkh76H8WT
📢 Follow for updates: https://linktr.ee/vincentlgamedev

Let’s build a great game together! 🏰
